targetText: In the Lower Status, the higher attributes of mankind begin to develop: personal dignity, eloquence, religious sensibility, rectitude, manliness and courage, now common traits of character; but there was also cruelty, treachery and fanaticism.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Marx's precis: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText: If there had been descent in male line, they would also have belonged to the same gens, and this would have been another obstacle to marriage.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
